changelog:
Initial release of the edit-image skill for modifying existing images.

- Enables adding, removing, replacing, recoloring, relighting, restoring, inpainting specific regions, or outpainting to extend the canvas of a single user-provided image.
- Supports multiple model routes: Qwen-Image-Edit for general instructions, Bria FIBO Edit for recolor/relight/blend, FLUX Erase for mask-driven removals, and FLUX models for inpaint and outpaint tasks.
- Requires user to provide a source image and a brief edit instruction; may also require a mask or region if the edit is localized.
- Distinct guidance and parameterization for each edit type, including pixel-level mask advice and outpainting by per-side extension.
- Clear workflow: select appropriate model, follow schema, upload image/mask, process synchronously, and validate result quality.
summary: Modify an image the user already has, by instruction or by mask. Use when the user says "remove the person/wires/watermark", "add a hat", "replace the sofa",...
